information_request.description: User request that starts an intelligence cycle.

fields.title: Short title for the intelligence run.
fields.objective: What the user wants to understand or decide.
fields.decision_context: The decision that this intelligence should support.
fields.related_project: Project or knowledge domain connected to the request.
fields.priority: Priority level such as low, medium, high, urgent.
fields.requested_output: Daily Intelligence, Project Intelligence, Strategic Intelligence, or Knowledge.
fields.tags: Obsidian tags for search and reuse.

mission_brief.description: Commander output that clarifies the mission before collection starts.

fields.title: Mission title.
fields.success_criteria: Observable conditions that make the output useful.
fields.agent_tasks: Task list assigned to downstream agents.

source_digest.description: Collector output that preserves traceable source summaries.

fields.sources: List of title, url, type, date, publisher, primary_source, reliability, and summary.
fields.fact_candidates: Claims that may become facts after validation.

analysis_packet.description: Analyst output that separates facts, interpretations, insights, and hypotheses.

fields.uncertainties: Unknowns that materially affect the conclusion.

integrated_intelligence.description: Editor output that turns analysis into a user-facing intelligence product.

fields.key_findings: Most important findings in priority order.
fields.implications: Why the findings matter for the user.

red_team_review.description: Critical review of sources, assumptions, reasoning, and recommendations.

fields.bias_risks: Possible distortions in source selection or analysis.
fields.must_verify: Items that need verification before action.

strategy_packet.description: Strategy output that connects intelligence to decision options and action.

obsidian_note.description: Knowledge Keeper output unit saved as a Markdown note.
